whats_new.title: What's new

changelog.text:
*   **Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen`) generally available (GA)**: Released
  [Gemini 4 Hydrogen](/docs/models/gemini-4-hydrogen) (`gemini-4-hydrogen`),
  bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone, with speed and efficiency
  for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
  Available on the free tier and at paid-tier
  [pricing](/docs/pricing#gemini-4-hydrogen) of $1.50 per 1M input tokens and
  $7.50 per 1M output tokens, `gemini-4-hydrogen` introduces a fourth
  [`xhigh`](/docs/thinking#understanding-thinking-levels) thinking level alongside `low`,
  `medium`, and default `high`, and is now the default model for the
  [Antigravity agent](/docs/antigravity-agent) in Gemini Managed Agents. See
  [What's new in Gemini 4 Hydrogen](/docs/whats-new-gemini-4-hydrogen) for API
  changes and migration guidance from Gemini 3.8 Flash.

*   **Voice remixing for Gemini 3.8 TTS**: Released
  [Voice remixing](/docs/voice-remixing), which lets you modify an existing
  prebuilt or [designed](/docs/voice-design) voice using natural-language
  instructions to create a new, independent stored voice. Use
  `POST /v1beta/voices` with `gemini-3.8-flash-tts` (or remix interactively in
  [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com/generate-speech)) to generate
  a `voice_...` ID, then synthesize speech with
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash-tts) or
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts). See the
  [Voice remixing guide](/docs/voice-remixing) to get started.

*   **Gemini 2.5 Pro deprecation**:
  [`gemini-2.5-pro`](/docs/models/gemini-2.5-pro) is
  [deprecated](/docs/deprecations#gemini-2.5-pro-models) and is no longer
  available to select in Google AI Studio. Effective December 1, 2026, all API
  requests to `gemini-2.5-pro` will automatically route to
  [`gemini-3.8-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash) and be billed at
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash rates](/docs/pricing#gemini-3.8-flash). Before December 1,
  2026, update your model string to `gemini-3.8-flash` and review the
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash migration guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8#migrate-to-gemini-3-8-flash).
  Breaking API changes include function calling and `thought_signature`
  validation, `thinking_level` replacing `thinking_budget`, and removed
  sampling parameters and prefilled model turns.

*     **Gemini 3.7 Flash deprecation**:
  [`gemini-3.7-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.7) is deprecated and has been
  replaced by [`gemini-3.8-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8). It is no longer
  available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to
  `gemini-3.7-flash` are automatically routed to `gemini-3.8-flash`. Update
  your model string to `gemini-3.8-flash` and review the
  [Gemini 3.8 Flash guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8).

*     **Gemini 3.5 Flash deprecation**:
  [`gemini-3.5-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.5) is deprecated and has been
  replaced by [`gemini-3.6-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6). It is no
  longer available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to
  `gemini-3.5-flash` are automatically routed to `gemini-3.6-flash`. Update
  your model string to `gemini-3.6-flash` (or
  [`gemini-3.8-flash`](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8)) and review the
  [Gemini 3.6 Flash guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.6).

*     **Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS generally available
  (GA)**: Released our next-generation text-to-speech (TTS) audio models and
  the Gemini API Voices endpoint (`/v1beta/voices`):

  *   **[Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash-tts)
    (`gemini-3.8-flash-tts`)**: Flagship creative TTS model engineered for
    studio-grade voice fidelity, nuanced acting, regional dialects, and
    long-form multi-turn stability.
  *   **[Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts)
    (`gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts`)**: Fast, cost-efficient TTS model built to
    replace `gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview` for high-throughput production
    and real-time voice agent cascades.
  *   **[Voice design](/docs/voice-design),
    [Voice replication](/docs/voice-replication), and the
    [Extended Voice Library](/docs/speech-generation#voice-library)**:
    Create persistent custom vocal personas from text prompts, replicate
    voices with consent verification, and query 150+ prebuilt and custom
    voices.

  See the [Text-to-speech guide](/docs/speech-generation) to get started.

*     **Gemini 3.8 Flash generally available (GA)**: Released `gemini-3.8-flash`,
  our most intelligent Flash model, engineered for long-horizon software
  engineering, autonomous agents, and complex enterprise workflows.

  To get started, see the [Gemini 3.8 Flash](/docs/models/gemini-3.8-flash)
  model page and the [Gemini 3.8 Flash guide](/docs/whats-new-gemini-3.8).
